restoration_note: Teaching 24 unfolds the doctrine of cosmic time: the Lord is without measure while every state of regeneration is measured. The teaching enumerates four/five great periods (the four wars, the panaretos at the end), with recurring formulas (ⲭⲛ̄ ⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲏⲩ 'from the time,' ⲦⲦⲙⲁϩ-N ⲡⲉ 'the Nth is,' ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ). Restorations are anchored on these formulas and on the Manichaean cosmogonic personnel (Father of Greatness, First Man, Mother of Life, Living Spirit, Great Builder, Pillar of Glory, Five Sons, Panaretos, bolos). The opening sections (1396–1399) and several middle sections (1488, 1496, 1499–1500, 1520–1521, 1550, 1556, 1584–1587) are too fragmentary for reconstruction. Editor proposals are confirmed where they fit the spiritual arc and the page's recurring vocabulary; weakly attested character-counts are flagged with low/moderate confidence.
